leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct an Axios instance with a custom base URL for API requests
Configure an Axios interceptor to attach an authorization token to request headers
Implement an interceptor to detect 401 Unauthorized responses from the server
Integrate a token refresh API call within the response interceptor logic
Manipulate the failed request's configuration to retry with a new access token
Control the interceptor flow to prevent infinite retry loops on refresh failures
Initialize a React component that uses the configured Axios instance for protected API calls
